nodes.source_excerpt: Chapter 196\n\nThe evening air crackled with anticipation as she stepped onto the gravel path, her camera bag slung over her shoulder. Ahead, a white tent glowed against the darkening sky, its canvas walls billowing gently in the breeze. The soft murmur of voices and the occasional click of a shutter drifted towards her, drawing her in like a moth to flame. ...

nodes.description: Dakari Hildebrand, the exhibition's curator, was found unconscious on the grass, raising concerns among attendees.
